# TulusSG

TulusSG is a ground-up community initiative supporting migrant communities in Singapore. It currently serves two distinct communities: migrant domestic workers, and migrant workers in sectors such as construction, marine, manufacturing and logistics. Each community has its own activities and channels. TulusSG works with volunteers and community partners to offer activities, learning opportunities and access to relevant resources.

Primary website: https://www.tulussg.com/
Contact: admin@tulussg.com
WhatsApp community (for migrant domestic workers): https://chat.whatsapp.com/F4tFULkpAh7EIJkxRVet8q?mode=gi_t
WhatsApp Channel (news, for everyone): https://whatsapp.com/channel/0029Vb8nWAZHLHQP94VdaV1b
Service area: Singapore

## Key facts

- The domestic worker community is working towards 1,000 members; on reaching that goal, TulusSG hopes to organise a TulusSG Sports Carnival
- Activities being explored for domestic workers (not yet confirmed): kayaking, football, floorball, pickleball, badminton, basketball, netball, piloxing, DRUMS UP, singing
- Activities for migrant workers: sport and recreation activities being planned (not yet confirmed)
- Each activity announcement states who can take part
- Current campaign: Share Your Story, for domestic helpers in Singapore
